svg.title: Proposed Azure production architecture
svg.desc: Internet users reach an Azure Application Gateway with WAF and autoscaling. It routes to Building Control and instrumentation in an internal, zone-redundant Azure Container Apps environment; each app keeps at least two replicas and scales on concurrent HTTP requests. Instrumentation polls Building Control privately. Physical devices exchange telemetry and optional commands with Azure IoT Hub. A separate ingestion worker reads the IoT Hub built-in Event Hubs-compatible endpoint, scales with KEDA on partition lag up to the partition count, and writes to Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server in a private delegated subnet. The database uses zone-redundant high availability, built-in PgBouncer and read replicas. Building Control may send commands through IoT Hub. This is a proposal; scaling requires application changes.
svg.text: Not implemented · each app scales independently once state and ingestion are safe to replicate
Dedicated gateway subnet · public / DMZ edge
Zone-redundant · separate apps and scale rules
Private DNS, outbound routes, secrets, logging, checkpoint storage and certificates omitted.
